name: control_app
description: Frappe compose template for the hub/control docker (composes an app named control)
_comment: Hub/control docker template. Unlike the tenant templates (all 'rcore_app'), this template is named 'control_app' so the composer derives an app named 'control' — the hub app keeps the name control per the owner ruling of 2026-08-20, matching the live hub's existing app name, so no app-rename migration is needed on the hub. The control module itself joins this list when the control repo's SDK-ification lands (separate wave). tender is composed here and ONLY here: tender is control-only per the owner ruling of 2026-08-18 — it must not appear in any tenant template. tender self-registers its gateway cmds from its control persona block (corporate#30), so no hook lines are needed here.

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.

modules.name: weather
modules._comment: Hub side of the role-split weather module (zones#54/#55): the severe-weather warnings engine, the weatherapi.com fetcher and the tenant-facing get_weather endpoint live in the module's src/control/ persona tree and compose only here; tenant products get the thin cached proxy from src/tenant/ via their own templates. Registry prep for control's compose switch — nothing composes this template until the control repo gains a composer.json/app_type marker. Pinned to zones main HEAD at time of entry (full-SHA pin per the composer's SHA-only clone rule).

modules.name: tender
modules._comment: TenderAssist module (SA public-sector tendering: opportunity catalog, tender bids with checklists, deterministic compliance layer). Control-only per the owner ruling of 2026-08-18. Pinned to corporate main after the 2026-08-21 waves (corporate#46/#42; picks up the wave-1/2/3 fixture rules, bid-pack generator, deterministic pack parser and eTenders fetcher landed since corporate#34); since corporate#30 the manifest self-registers the module's gateway cmds from its control persona block — no whitelisted_methods/hook lines are needed in this template. The full-SHA ref pin is intentional — the composer only accepts SHA pins when cloning (hard-fails unpinned refs), unlike the legacy 'main' refs above which predate that rule.

modules.name: fleet
modules._comment: Fleet SDK module (control-split step 4, control#181): hub registry and channel, server agent, lifecycle, moves, rings and the fleet board, composed to {app}.fleet.control.* with doctypes under {app}/fleet/doctype/ (Frappe module fleet). Its manifest is the single source of the fleet scheduler jobs, doc_events, control: cmds and control_upgrade_result; control 1.7.1 registers its shim-path copies only when fleet is not composed. The cohosted duplicate-doctype scan skips SDK module dirs (any subdir with a manifest.json) inside a cohosted app checkout, so control/fleet/frappe does not count as control's own doctypes. Pinned to control main cb6d4ad (after control#190: fleet 1.6.0, control 1.15.0); every control-repo module shares this pin because the composer clones one ref per repo.

modules.name: provisioning
modules._comment: Provisioning SDK module from the control repo (control-split, control#183), composed to {app}.provisioning.control.*. Shares the control-repo pin with fleet because the composer takes the clone ref from the first module of each repo.
